item.title: Integrate Firebase Manually into iOS App
item.description: Let’s assume we want to build an app for iOS / macOS or tvOS. We only want to use Swift Package Manager as Package Manager and we know we have to use Firebase. Maybe you have similar reasons, you don’t want to change project structure with using Cocoapods and maybe don’t want to use Carthage etc. I encounter with this situation and solve with a little bit struggling way because even Google’s documentation is not complete in this integration ways.
